answer: An answer must include the first 19 hex characters of the seed it was derived under, and a wrong or missing derivation is rejected at intake. Because the dawn derivation is checked against the island nonce, the echo audit keeps the accepted values and a reused text fails on the first character. That binds the text to one identity's challenge, so copying between 82 aliases produces 82 mismatches and pays the authoring cost with no payout. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
